jess: FYI Acme demo tomorrow needs a hosted API token for the live walkthrough. Requirements: one-time use preferred, streaming allowed, IP whitelist 203.0.113.128/25, TTL=4h, tag `sales/acme_demo_live`, mark as POC non-prod. Don't paste token in public channels.

mike: I can mint a one-time ephemeral token with TTL 4h and single-use flag. Will set scopes: generate,stream. Confirm IP range and add metadata `demo:2025-05-10 created_by:sales_jess`?

jess: correct. Also set audit retention 90d and add `revocation_owner:sales`. Paul (SE) should get token via DM during the call.

paul-se: pls DM me 10m before demo. I'll test connectivity from the demo host. Reminder: demo app uses streaming SSE endpoint.

tara: i'll attach a quick rotate-and-revoke checklist to ticket SLS-5101: 1) issue token, 2) DM SE, 3) demo, 4) revoke token, 5) verify logs.

security: add policy: revoke-on-idle 24h and ensure tokens are not stored in shared docs. Approve one-time use for external demos. :lock:

ops-bot: SLS-5101 created and queued for provisioning. audit_policy=90d revoke_on_idle=24h

mike: token minted id=tok_01ACMEDEMO expires=1775559155 (4h), single_use=true, ip_allowlist=203.0.113.128/25. audit: https://console.redwood.ai/projects/acme/poc/logs?ticket=SLS-5101

mike: DM sent to @paul-se with token and expiry. example curl to stream (for SE):
```bash
curl -N -H "Authorization: Bearer REDWOOD_ACME_DEMO_<REDACTED>" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw-stream-1","input":"hello"}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/stream
```

jess: Got it. After demo rotate immediately and confirm revoke in audit logs. Tara will close SLS-5101 after verification. Thanks :rocket:
